text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Fees (Certificate of Clearance) Order 2010 and shall come into operation on 1st November 2010.

2.—(1) A fee of $55 shall be payable to the Director, Criminal Investigation Department, Singapore, for the issue of a certificate stating that the person named therein has not been convicted of any crime in Singapore prior to the date of the issue of the certificate.
(2) A fee of $25 shall be payable to the Director, Criminal Investigation Department, Singapore, for an additional copy of the certificate.
[S 251/2014 wef 01/04/2014]
(3) An additional fee of $5 shall be payable in the case where the certificate or a copy thereof is posted to an applicant outside Singapore.
[S 251/2014 wef 01/04/2014]
3. The Fees (Certificate of No Criminal Conviction) Order (O 40C) is revoked.
